message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta, but it’s handled by the city’s **Code Enforcement** and **Police Department** rather than the city council itself. Here’s how to do it: | Step | What to Do | Where/How | |------|------------|-----------| | 1 | **Check the Noise Ordinance** | Atlanta’s noise ordinance (Chapter 10‑2 of the Atlanta Code) sets the limits and hours for acceptable noise.
📎 [Noise Ordinance PDF](https://www.atlantaga.gov/sites/default/files/2024-02/Noise%20Ordinance.pdf) | | 2 | **File Online** | Use the 311 online portal or the “Noise Complaint” form.
🔗 [Atlanta 311 – Noise Complaint](https://www.atlantaga.gov/311) | | 3 | **Call 311** | If you prefer phone, call 311 (or 404‑656‑3111). The dispatcher will route your complaint to the appropriate department. | | 4 | **Visit a Police Station** | For urgent or ongoing issues, you can also file a complaint in person at any Atlanta Police Department precinct. | | 5 | **Contact Your Council Member** | If you want to bring the issue to the city council’s attention, you can email or call your local council member’s office. They can refer you to the correct department or advocate on your behalf.
📞 404‑656‑3111 (City Hall) or visit the council member’s page on the city website. | ### Quick Contact Details | Department | Phone | Email | Website | |------------|-------|-------|---------| | **Atlanta Police Department – Code Enforcement** | 404‑656‑3111 (311) | code.enforcement@atlantaga.gov | https://www.atlantaga.gov/department-of-public-safety | | **City of Atlanta 311** | 404‑656‑3111 | 311@atlantaga.gov | https://www.atlantaga.gov/311 | | **City Council** | 404‑656‑3111 | council@atlantaga.gov | https://www.atlantaga.gov/city-council | ### Tips - **Document the Noise**: Record the time, duration, and type of noise (e.g., music, construction, barking dogs). This helps officers assess the complaint. - **Know the Hours**: The ordinance typically prohibits loud noise from 10 p.m. to 7 a.m. on weekdays and 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. on weekends. If the noise occurs outside these hours, it’s more likely to be actionable. - **Follow Up**: If you don’t hear back within a few days, call 311 or the Code Enforcement office to check the status. So, while you can’t file a noise complaint directly with the city council, you can easily report it through the city’s official channels, and the council can help if you need additional support.
